name: Alpha
notes: The 25th monster: a random species (never the player's), in its rare Alpha colors with a golden crown and sparkles. Its level grows while it sleeps: it starts each run at level 5 and gains 1 at every whole minute on the run clock (6 at 1:00, 7 at 2:00 ... up to 15 at 10:00), until the other 24 have fainted and it wakes; then its level stays (the game variable boss_level, raised by the player's run clock). 180 HP at any level, its move 1 hits 1.5x harder (its moves 2 and 3 at normal power: a 40-power move 3 hits for 64 at level 5 up to 124 at level 15, and a super-effective one for 96 up to 186, so from level 10 up a super-effective move 3 can knock out a full-HP player in one blow), and it gives 60 XP. It sleeps in the stone circle of the south-east clearing until the other 24 have fainted, then wakes with a roar for the final fight: the run music stops under the roar and, 40 ticks later, the boss theme (mus_boss) starts and plays until the run ends (unless the run already ended in those 40 ticks).Unlike the other wild monsters it uses all 3 of its species' moves: it attacks every 3.3 s, and each attack is its move 3 (R) when that has recharged, else its move 2 (B), else its move 1 (A). Moves 2 and 3 recharge twice as slowly as the player's (move 2: 20 s; move 3: 20-120 s depending on the move) and are both ready when it wakes, so the fight opens with its move 3, then its move 2. While it flies (Gustling's Fly) only its shadow shows. Like the others it keeps 1 tile of room from other wild monsters. Like every wild monster it blinks red 3 times when hit. When it comes into view (its whole body at least 32 px inside the screen, below the top HUD panel) its level shows over its head in cyan (LV5 to LV15) for 3 s; the tag vanishes the moment a move reaches it. After more than 5 s out of that view it counts as unseen again, so coming back shows the tag again. The tag sits above its crown. If its species' type is the run's world, it is at home: it hits 10% harder, walks 10% faster, attacks 10% more often and its moves 2 and 3 recharge 10% sooner. Matchup tag: its level tag is yellow when the player's type is super effective on it (the x1.5! color), grey when it resists the player's type (the x0.75 color), else cyan. Spotted: when it turns hostile a yellow '!' pops up over its head (above the level tag) and its cry plays; if that happens out of sight, they wait until it walks into view. Knock-out freeze: when it faints the whole world stops for 2/3 s (pause_world), the killing blow's red flash and number held still, then it blinks out and the rest of its on_death runs. Shiny seed (classic only): it writes its random species into boss_species when the run starts. When it faints (the last of the 25), the run is won, its clock stops and the music stops; then, if its species is unlocked (can be picked on the menu) and not shiny yet, it leaves a shiny seed where it fainted, revealed as it blinks out, with a sparkling jingle (sfx_shiny), and the run waits until the player picks the seed up (item_shiny_seed: then the victory screen, which makes that species shiny, and the shiny screen). Otherwise nothing drops: the screen holds 3 s after it has blinked out (so it is clear there is no seed), then fades to the victory screen.
